spans.text: [55:1] ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ Alrrahmanu The Most Merciful [55:2] عَلَّمَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ AAallama alqurana Taught the Qur'an [55:3] خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ Khalaqa alinsana Created man [55:4] عَلَّمَهُ ٱلۡبَيَانَ AAallamahu albayana [And] taught him eloquence [55:5] ٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُ بِحُسۡبَانٖ Alshshamsu waalqamaru bihusbanin The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation [55:6] وَٱلنَّجۡمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسۡجُدَانِ Waalnnajmu waalshshajaru yasjudani And the stars and trees prostrate [55:7] وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ Waalssamaa rafaAAaha wawadaAAa almeezana And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance [55:8] أَلَّا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡمِيزَانِ Alla tatghaw fee almeezani That you not transgress within the balance [55:9] وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ Waaqeemoo alwazna bialqisti wala tukhsiroo almeezana And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance [55:10] وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلۡأَنَامِ Waalarda wadaAAaha lilanami And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures [55:11] فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ وَٱلنَّخۡلُ ذَاتُ ٱلۡأَكۡمَامِ Feeha fakihatun waalnnakhlu thatu alakmami Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates] [55:12] وَٱلۡحَبُّ ذُو ٱلۡعَصۡفِ وَٱلرَّيۡحَانُ Waalhabbu thoo alAAasfi waalrrayhani And grain having husks and scented plants [55:13] فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny [55:14] خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ كَٱلۡفَخَّارِ Khalaqa alinsana min salsalin kaalfakhkhari He created man from clay like [that of] pottery [55:15] وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٖ مِّن نَّارٖ Wakhalaqa aljanna min marijin min narin And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire [55:16] فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny [55:17] رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَغۡرِبَيۡنِ Rabbu almashriqayni warabbu almaghribayni [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets [55:18] فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny [55:19] مَرَجَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ يَلۡتَقِيَانِ Maraja albahrayni yaltaqiyani He released the two seas, meeting [side by side] [55:20] بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخٞ لَّا يَبۡغِيَانِ Baynahuma barzakhun la yabghiyani Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses [55:21] فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny [55:22] يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُمَا ٱللُّؤۡلُؤُ وَٱلۡمَرۡجَانُ Yakhruju minhuma alluluo waalmarjanu From both of them emerge pearl and coral [55:23] فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny [55:24] وَلَهُ ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ Walahu aljawari almunshaatu fee albahri kaalaAAlami And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains [55:25] فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny [55:26] كُلُّ مَنۡ عَلَيۡهَا فَانٖ Kullu man AAalayha fanin Everyone upon the earth will perish [55:27] وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ Wayabqa wajhu rabbika thoo aljalali waalikrami And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor [55:28] فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny [55:29] يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنٖ Yasaluhu man fee alssamawati waalardi kulla yawmin huwa fee shanin Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter [55:30] فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny [55:31] سَنَفۡرُغُ لَكُمۡ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ Sanafrughu lakum ayyuha alththaqalani We will attend to you, O prominent beings [55:32] فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny [55:33] يَٰمَعۡشَرَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنۡ أَقۡطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱنفُذُواْۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ Ya maAAshara aljinni waalinsi ini istataAAtum an tanfuthoo min aqtari alssamawati waalardi faonfuthoo la tanfuthoona illa bisultanin O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass.
